summary: The ReportMain system handles report generation, export, and email functionalities with extensive error handling and parameter configurations. It supports multiple file types and formats for exporting reports, including CSV, RTF, TXT, DOC, and PDF. The system ensures the correct setup of database connections and report parameters, including handling exceptions and ensuring proper resource cleanup.
purpose: To generate, export, and manage reports in various formats and handle email notifications with flexible parameter settings and error handling.

workflows.name: Generate and Export Report
steps: Set up database login details for each report table
Log on to each table in any subreport
Set export format based on OutputType
Set export destination to disk file
Convert RTF to plain text if required

workflows.name: Delete Old Files
steps: Set cutoff date as current date minus one day
List all files with the specified prefix
Delete files older than cutoff date

business_rules: Default to CSV format if not specified
Fallback to generic error message if unknown error occurs
Use alternative report file if alt locale is set and file exists
validations: Check if report and its database tables are null
Validate email addresses before sending emails
calculations: Generate unique file name with Hashing.GenerateFileName()
Convert date and time to appropriate format
conditions: Use alternative report file if available for session's locale
Convert RTF output to plain text for email notifications
system_behavior: Exports reports to specified format and location
Sends email notifications if email data are valid
Handles exceptions in file operations and database connectivity
Deletes files older than one day with specified prefix
